Name: Stardew Valley Planner
Author: HPeinar
Description:
Online planning tool for Stardew Valley at [url=https://stardew.info/planner]﻿﻿https://stardew.info/planner

[/url]The planner offers a 2D planning grid for official and most popular community made maps.
Figure out where to place paths and where to grow these beautiful ﻿starfruits.

[b]Features:
[/b][list]
[*]Place, drag, delete and move all Stardew stuff on your farm!
[*]Features all official maps and many community made maps like Farm Extended or Memory Farm
[*]Plan for any of the seasons, has all the crops from all the seasons.
[*]Shows effective radius for things like bee-hives or scare-crows to make sure you have your fields covered
[*]Possibility to save & share your farm so you can discuss your ideas in forums / chats.
[*]Import your current layout directly from the saveGame file
[*]Has coordinates information for modders 
[*]In partnership with ﻿[url=https://upload.farm/]https://upload.farm/[/url] you can also render your creations to in-game like pictures (only works with official farms)
[/list]
The planner also has a [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/stardewplanner/]Facebook group[/url] where people share and discuss different plans and farm ideas!
You can also find us from [url=https://discord.gg/QBqBAzp]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ in #stardew-planner channel.
